title: VooPoo Drag 5 Box Mod
description: The Voopoo Drag 5 Box Mod is the perfect choice for vapers seeking a high-performance device with versatility and advanced features. Powered by dual 18650 batteries (sold separately) , the Drag 5 delivers a maximum output of 177W, ensuring robust performance and extended vaping sessions. The unique wrap-around C-frame cover allows for easy battery replacement, and the device features an indicator that displays whether the battery is safe and suitable for use. The Drag 5 is equipped with Voopoo’s upgraded GENE.TT 2.0 chipset, which provides rapid firing and a range of interactive features, including an optional flame animation. The chipset also supports multiple safety protections, such as overcharge, short circuit, and over-discharge protections, ensuring a safe and reliable vaping experience. The device supports four vape modes adjustable via the menu: SMART Mode for easy coil detection and power adjustment; RBA Mode for DIY enthusiasts; energy-saving ECO Mode; and TC Mode for precise temperature control. The 3-In-1 Flip Switch controls multiple functions, including Lock ignition, Lock Power, and a one-button switch for firing. The Drag 5 Box Mod features a 510-thread connection, allowing users to pair the device with any compatible tank of their choice, offering unmatched flexibility and customization. Combining luxurious aesthetics with comfort and durability, the Drag 5's ergonomic design features leather and zinc alloy construction and is available in seven colours to suit your style. . Please Note: Batteries are NOT included with this Mod.
